name: Yatari Misa
source: Yagari Misa is an 11 year old shrine maiden in a sex ritual passed down for many generations in her village. 18 year old Izumo Rokuta doesn't want to hurt her so he refuses to take part in the ritual. However, it's only a matter of time before the men convince him to do it.
